updates.датасет: Published adult female Drosophila connectome; Methods Table 1 reports 131,459 nodes and 32,970,606 edges, alongside average degree 501.6 before and 37.01 after combining multiple edges. The table does not establish that the 32,970,606 figure is the unique pairwise-edge denominator; the distinct counts need provenance reconciliation. Exact immutable graph materialization was not established.
